detail.longDescription: Inside PH4NTXM: #6 Lone Wolf Mode A Tor setting is only useful when the rest of the network obeys it. PH4NTXM's Lone Wolf mode builds a dedicated routing policy around system Tor. Supported application TCP traffic follows the Tor path, while arbitrary application UDP and IPv6 are blocked. DNS goes through a local bridge into Tor's DNSPort. Required local link setup has its own allowances. Browser launch depends on protection readiness and completed Tor bootstrap. The routing policy is designed to contain application traffic when Tor is unavailable, rather than offer an automatic direct-network fallback. # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology
